text:
maria_p: Seeing intermittent shutdown hang in a FastAPI service that stores a single httpx.AsyncClient on app.state. Sometimes uvicorn never exits and we get 'RuntimeError: Event loop is closed'.

maria_p: Tiny repro: create AsyncClient at startup, background tasks use it, then on shutdown await client.aclose() and occasionally it blocks.

alex: I saw this in tests too when loops are torn down by pytest-asyncio. Sounds like transport/loop ownership mismatch.

jamie: Httpx transports are bound to the loop that created them. If aclose runs on a different loop/thread you can hit closed loop errors.

maria_p: We're on httpx 0.24.1 with uvloop. Repro locally but nondeterministic.

sam_sdk: Action: add a FastAPI lifespan example to SDK docs showing safe AsyncClient lifetime, and an async context manager helper in our SDK. Also add types so misuse gets flagged by mypy.

maria_p: Short-term fix: use AsyncExitStack in lifespan to cancel background tasks before aclose. Reduced occurrences.

jamie: Also put a small CI example (uvloop + pytest-asyncio) in examples to catch regressions.

devex-bot: Backlog note created: DEVEX-412 async client lifecycle examples + SDK async context manager.

alex: I'll open a PR with a lifespan example and a "shutdown pitfalls" section. Will paste the failing trace in the PR.

maria_p: Thanks — will help with a tiny repro for the PR.

jamie: Recommend SDK helper API: create_async_client_for_lifespan() and RedwoodClient async context manager. Keeps users from storing global AsyncClient incorrectly.

sam_sdk: I'll prototype types and tests for the context manager.

maria_p: Failing trace snippet: RuntimeError: Event loop is closed (in httpx._transports.asyncio.AsyncioBackend.send)

alex: Great thread. Let's prioritize docs + small example CI to avoid future surprises. :thumbsup:
